description:
The Senior Sales Executive is responsible for developing new business opportunities and managing Chinese buyers, vendors and key accounts within the Electronics & Electrical sector. The role focuses on new client acquisition, sales target achievement, market development and delivering high-quality customer service.
Key Responsibilities
* Identify and develop new Chinese clients while maintaining strong relationships with existing buyers, vendors and key accounts.
* Handle sales enquiries, prepare quotations and presentations, negotiate and close deals, and manage customer feedback, complaints and objections.
* Analyze customer needs and business opportunities to maximize sales potential and promote appropriate testing services.
* Develop and implement sales, marketing and PR activities; conduct market research to identify new testing services and business opportunities.
* Monitor competitor pricing, testing capabilities and market developments, providing insights to support sales strategies.
* Monitor sales KPIs and prepare regular sales forecasts, client/revenue reports and business performance updates.
* Collaborate with internal teams to achieve sales targets and provide excellent customer service.
requirements_text:
* At least 3 years of experience in B2B hunter sales , with a proven track record in developing new customers and achieving sales targets.
* Good Chinese communication and writing skills , with intermediate English communication and writing ability.
* Strong selling, communication, presentation and negotiation skills with a proactive and target-driven mindset.
* Understanding of third-party testing/services industries is preferred.
* Knowledge of the Electronics & Electrical supply chain, particularly Apple OEM/ODM manufacturers such as Antran, Tonly, Foxconn, PYD, Pegatron and WNC, is an advantage.
* Able to independently conduct client visits, organize technical seminars and deliver customer presentations.
